notes.title: Bugfix & Tutorial Updates
notes.notes: [p]Hello everyone, this is the list of some bugfix and small changes for today![/p][h2]Bugfix & Tutorial Updates[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed a bug where stocker mixes some ammo types.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where some colliders missing on items after canceling the placement.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where you can't unlock the dialouge for selling brass box.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some skin name issues[/p][/*][*][p]Added new tutorial features for new players to navigate on tablet easier![/p][/*][*][p]Some optimization for lights and map![/p][/*][*][p]Added a new feature on case opening to know acquired skins bundles! [/p][/*][*][p]Sprays bottles are now in bundles of 5 and stations that use spray bottles, capacity is now 10![/p][p][/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Small Changes & Bugfix
notes.notes: [h2]Small Changes & Bugfix[/h2][list][*][p]Weapon cleaning machine now uses sprays.[/p][/*][*][p]Localization fixes[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed game crashing when empty cargo boxes placed in storage shelf.[/p][/*][*][p]Some fixes on in game models.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Here Is Some Bugfix & Small Changes
notes.notes: [h3]Hello everyone![/h3][p]Thank you to all who played our game, joined our community, and gave us feedback. We are going to update this game and add more content until it is ready for the full release, and this is only possible thanks to you. Here is a list of some fixed bugs and changes to make you enjoy this game more! [/p][p][/p][h2]Bugfix & Small Changes[/h2][list][*][p][b]Storage shelves now have labels so you can keep track of your items![/b][/p][/*][*][p]Some items had large placement borders so we trimmed them down for better placements![/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that causing customers to stuck when player takes a skin from display case.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where some guns are uninteractable.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where some items can't be stored on storage shelves.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Corrupted Saves Hotfix
notes.notes:
[h2]Corrupted Saves Hotfix[/h2][p]Some players got the issue where their save files got corrupted, thanks to your feedback we were able to fix it so you can continue your save! Please report us any issues you have via Discord so we can fix it right away! Discord Link -> [url="https://discord.gg/ZtnAGctU2z"]https://discord.gg/ZtnAGctU2z[/url][/p][p][/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Bug fixes & Museum Changes

notes.title: Day 1 Bug Fixes & Improvements
notes.notes: [p]Thank you for playing our game from the launch day! We fixed bugs and improved the game thanks to your feedback. Here is a list for general changes on this update.[/p][p][/p][h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed money from balloons falling down from plane.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed game lagging while music is changing.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed wrong daily report stats.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Receptionist going range for taking ammo bug.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed game crashing after placing BrassBox to the storage shelf bug.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some localization issues.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed weapon cleaning station bugs.[/p][/*][/list][h2]Improvements & Changes[/h2][list][*][p]Increased Workers speed.[/p][/*][*][p]Receptionist isn’t going to reception every time he picks up an item.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced sound for picking up ammo shells with machine.[/p][/*][*][p]Small optimizations for medium quality.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved tutorial for better understanding.[/p][/*][/list][p]You can join our discord for giving feedback or reporting bugs to help us make this game better.[/p][p]->[url="https://discord.gg/ZtnAGctU2z"]https://discord.gg/ZtnAGctU2z[/url][/p][h3]  [/h3]
